description: "Play X [on/in Y]" answered on the local agent through Music Assistant, so music requests skip Claude. Y: the family room stereo (also the default), the HomePod, the kitchen, the basement, or the whole house (also "everywhere", "all speakers", "every room"): Music Assistant's Whole House sync group of the Kitchen Echo and the HomePod (Ty left the basement out: no whole-house music downstairs). The Family Room Stereo can't join it: the WiiM Ultra has no AirPlay and can't run Sendspin over Cast. "X by Y" is a song with its artist; "X playlist" or "X album" sets the type. Songs or music by X, and X songs, play the artist X when Music Assistant knows one by that exact name. A request naming another target (a TV) or too vague to search ("some music") is handed to Claude as said. If Music Assistant finds nothing, it says so; if nothing started because another speaker is already streaming Tidal (the account allows one stream at a time), it says that instead. Once it plays, the Show's Music pop-up is pointed at that speaker (input_text.music_speaker). One wildcard sentence, with the speaker read from its end: separate sentences per speaker lost to the bare wildcard.

variables.found: {{ trigger.slots.query | trim | regex_findall('^(.*?) (?:(?:on|in|through|throughout|to) (?:the )?(family room stereo|family room|stereo|big speakers|homepod|home pod|kitchen speaker|kitchen echo|kitchen|basement stereo|basement speakers|basement receiver|basement|whole house|entire house|all speakers|all the speakers|every room|all rooms)|(everywhere|all over the house))$', ignorecase=True) }}

variables.key: {{ keys[(found[0][1] or found[0][2]) | lower] if found else 'stereo' }}
variables.q: {{ (found[0][0] if found else raw) | trim | regex_replace('^(me |us )?(some|a little|a bit of) ', '') | trim }}

variables.vague: {{ q | lower in ['music', 'something', 'anything', 'a song', 'songs', 'some music', 'something good', 'tunes'] }}
variables.elsewhere: {{ not named and (q | lower) is search(' (on|in|through|to) (the )?[a-z0-9 ]+$') }}
variables.kind: {{ 'playlist' if q | lower is search(' playlist$') else ('album' if q | lower is search(' album$') else '') }}
variables.name: {{ q | regex_replace('(?i) (playlist|album)$', '') | trim }}

variables.title: {{ name.split(' by ')[0] | trim if ' by ' in name else name }}
variables.artist: {{ name.split(' by ', 1)[1] | trim if ' by ' in name else '' }}

variables.artist_q: {% set g = ['song', 'songs', 'a song', 'some songs', 'music', 'some music', 'something', 'anything', 'stuff', 'tracks', 'tunes', 'hits', 'the hits'] %}{% if artist != '' and title | lower in g %}{{ artist }}{% else %}{% set m = name | regex_findall('^(.+?) (?:songs|music|tracks|tunes|hits)$', ignorecase=True) %}{{ m[0] if m else '' }}{% endif %}

variables.match: {% set want = artist_q | lower | regex_replace('^the ', '') %}{% set ns = namespace(m='') %}{% for x in ((found.artists if found is defined and found is mapping and 'artists' in found else []) or []) %}{% if ns.m == '' and (x.name | lower | regex_replace('^the ', '')) == want %}{% set ns.m = x.name %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.m }}

then.set_conversation_response: Playing {{ state_attr(player, 'media_title') or name }}{{ (' by ' ~ state_attr(player, 'media_artist')) if state_attr(player, 'media_artist') and state_attr(player, 'media_artist') | lower not in (state_attr(player, 'media_title') or '') | lower else '' }} {{ where }}.

else.set_conversation_response: {% set ns = namespace(by='') %}{% for e in ['media_player.whole_house', 'media_player.family_room_stereo', 'media_player.homepod', 'media_player.kitchen', 'media_player.basement_stereo'] %}{% if ns.by == '' and e != player and is_state(e, 'playing') and 'tidal' in (state_attr(e, 'media_content_id') or '') %}{% set ns.by = state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if ns.by %}Tidal only plays one stream at a time, and the {{ ns.by }} is already playing it. Stop that first, then ask again.{% else %}I couldn't find {{ name }} in your music.{% endif %}
